She invites Swedish fire-chef Niklas Esktedt to share the joys of cave-man cooking with her, and enjoys his inventive venison meatballs with blackened celeriac and mouth-watering Swedish donuts.

Mary takes her inspiration from a visit to a groundbreaking primary school in south London which has built a secret garden where they teach their students how to grow vegetables and look after a brood of chickens.
programme.title: Classic Mary Berry

Mary makes her way through vegetable rows and orchards, ending with her own inspired version of the delicious tarte tatin.
programme.title: Classic Mary Berry

programme.desc: S08 E05 — Joseph & Sabrina Joseph's been sending Sabrina his love and his money, but his sister doesn't buy Sabrina's lies and calls in Nev and Kamie for some truth.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S07 E23 — Truth & Ray'Quan L.A. fashion designer Truth is hot for his online crush Ray'Quan despite the fact he's in a relationship in real life.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S08 E16 — Stephanie & Danny Nev and Kamie are shocked to hear that Stephanie has been talking to Danny for 10 years but had never video chatted or even spoken to him.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S08 E11 — Jason & Keith In the first ever virtual episode, Nev and Kamie won't let the quarantine stop them from helping love struck Jason find the dirt on his Insta-model Keith; remote from home, the hosts unite forces to expose the truth.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S07 E19 — Mike & Joey Nev and co-host Jane Carrey help aspiring sugar baby Mike chooses between his Los Angeles life of leisure and his deep affection for the mysterious Joey, a broke mechanic he fell in love with on Grindr.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S08 E27 — DeJuan & Tynea Nev and Kamie unearth a mystery involving twin sisters; it threatens to extinguish DeJuan's love for Tynea forever.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S08 E36 — Bryn & Stephanie Bryn thought he'd met the one when he was introduced to Stephanie, but as Nev and Kamie poke holes in Stephanie's story, Bryn begins to doubt his dreams, especially when a surprise call threatens to end their whole relationship.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S08 E29 — Jason & Mar California preacher Jason thought Mar was the one when they matched on Jack'd, but Mar would never meet up. After Nev and Kamie find out that Mar could be a girl scamming him for money, Jason has to confront some hard truths.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S08 E25 — Eric & Lianna Eric falls for Lianna but despite living nearby, she is a no-show three times; Nev and Kamie uncover a rabbit hole that runs deeper than they could have imagined.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S08 E15 — Kirsten & Alex Kirsten met Alex a month ago online while she was stuck living under quarantine with her ex fiancé; Alex then confesses to being a catfish and ghosts.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S03 E18 — Fire and Desire Jamie and Uncle Junior rewire the hotel; Jamie dates Fancy's gold-digging pal.

programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S04 E01 — Just Fancy Fancy mistakes a hotel guest, Debbe Dunning, for Jamie's girlfriend; Braxton schemes to bring Fancy's ex-fiancé back into the picture.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S01 E05 — My Fair Marlon Marlon (Marlon Wayans) uses Shawn's (Shawn Wayans) poetry to woo a woman, only to have his plan backfire.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S01 E08 — The Shawn-Shank Redemption Shawn and Marlon are thrown into jail for unpaid parking tickets.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S13 E01 — The 11th Hour In the 404, the voice of the South is ever rising, and it reaches a fever pitch when Bambi & Spice raise the bars; Karlie's recent split is the word around town; Scrappy's situationship with Shakira might set his new relationship off course.
programme.title: Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta

programme.desc: S13 E02 — Sound the Retreat Spice and Bambi's wellness retreat takes a turn for the worse; Salma Slims takes over the ATL music scene; Erica Dixon makes an unexpected appearance.
programme.title: Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta

programme.desc: S13 E03 — Off Key Queen Key sets the tone at her ATL debut; Joc's idea to have Salma and Erica Banks on the same track goes off the rails; a round of relationship gossip has Yandy putting some of her relationship on ice.
programme.title: Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta

programme.desc: S13 E04 — Post Modern Family Karlie tries to figure out her life after lockup; Mendeecees finally gives his side of the Frost's story; Sierra's mom turns what should be a happy announcement about her growing family into a growing pain.
programme.title: Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta

programme.desc: S13 E05 — The Tight Faces of ATL Momma Dee meets up with Britney; while Banks packs for her upcoming show, her girlfriend reveals she's packing; Ashley's desires put her under suspicion with Zane; Joc and his family suffer a tragic loss.
programme.title: Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta

programme.desc: S13 E06 — Remember the Acrimony Sierra and Zae grieve an unexpected loss; Erica Banks hopes her papa won't preach when he finds out about her soon-to-be holy matrimony; new rumors about the Harris' hit the blogs.
programme.title: Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta

programme.desc: S13 E07 — On My Momma Queen Key's attempt to get Salma and Erica Banks to collaborate leaves them all feeling diss-missed; cheating accusations surface, causing Bambi to question if her fiancé is the Ray of light she thought he was.
programme.title: Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta

programme.desc: S13 E08 — Rules of Engagement Joc helps bring his family some peace through the strife when he brings his brother Kwame home; in Chicago, Queen Key celebrates a milestone for her kids, but when it comes to her mom, she might take the L.
programme.title: Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta

programme.desc: S13 E09 — Girls Interrupted Sierra's friends worry that her gated emotions have taken its toll on her; Zane tries to get his mom and Ashley back on the same page, but Ashley's surprise party guests may hinder their happy ending.
programme.title: Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta

programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S41 E01 — Welcome to the Challenge The newly formed pairs of Challenge Vets and New Threats must put their partnership to the test immediately; a rivalry causes chaos and uncertainty, leading to drama-filled nominations; a nail-biting elimination sends shockwave.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E02 — We Used to Hook Up TJ throws a huge wrench in the players' plans, making an ever-changing game even more difficult; two challengers get hot and heavy, making another begin to boil over with jealousy; the elimination sees the first head banger.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E03 — I Am The Challenge One player's game is at risk, while their partner's competitiveness rears its ugly head and wishes it hadn't. The challenge tests the players' swimming skills for the first time and an added element makes some of the veterans lo.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E04 — Wish I'd Been Practicing The stakes are sky-high, as one veteran shocks the house by getting last in the challenge; Hangnail, Gabe, looks to make a high-risk move to earn back some favor; the challenge tests the players' sense of direction and Sudoku.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E05 — Pride Comes Before the Fall The rivalry between vets and new threats heats up; worlds collide when the sports-horror movie "HIM" from Director Jordan Peele gets in on the action; a new threat is taken off guard when the challenge loser wants to swing big and take them out.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Starring Jimmy Fallon and hosted by Keke Palmer, the iconic word-guessing game features celebrities teaming up with everyday contestants. These teams play a modern and refreshed version of the game that's inspired by classic Password, Password Plus, Super Password and the viral celebrity Password games seen on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Players compete over three rounds of gameplay, taking turns trying to get their partner to guess the password using one-word clues. The team with the most points after two rounds heads to the bonus round, where they have 60 seconds to get the celebrity guests to correctly guess 10 passwords for a chance to win as much as $25,000.

Meanwhile, the turkey is left stewing while the losing team calls for a rematch.
programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E12 — The One With All the Jealousy Ross becomes increasingly jealous of Rachel's sexy new colleague, Mark, and gets the wrong end of the stick when he spies on Rachel at her office. Meanwhile, Monica is enamoured with a sexy bus boy who writes love poems for her, and Joey gets himself into trouble by faking his CV in order to get a part in a Broadway musical.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E13 — The One Where Monica and Richard Are Just Friends Monica bumps into Richard in a video store, and they decide to work on their friendship, but the more time they spend together, the more sexual their relationship becomes. Meanwhile, Phoebe dates an athlete who unintentionally keeps exposing himself by wearing loose shorts, and Rachel agrees to read 'The Shining' if Joey will read 'Little Women'.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E14 — The One With Phoebe's Ex-Partner Phoebe is reunited with her former singing partner, Leslie, a failed television commercial jingle writer who wants to use Phoebe's signature song 'Smelly Cat' in an advertisement for cat litter. Meanwhile, Ross becomes jealous when Rachel agrees to go to a fashion lecture with Mark, a former colleague who has just left for a new job, and Chandler meets a beautiful woman, Ginger, who has a prosthetic leg.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E15 — The One Where Ross and Rachel Take a Break Rachel's job prevents her from celebrating her anniversary with Ross. Wanting more time to focus on her new job, she suggests the two take a break from their relationship. programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E16 — The One With the Morning After Ross tries to prevent Rachel from learning his disturbing secret. Meanwhile, Monica, Phoebe, Chandler and Joey spend a night eavesdropping.
programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: Cultures collide when an introverted doctor brings his white boyfriend home to meet his traditional East Indian family.
programme.title: A Nice Indian Boy

programme.desc: Story of the chase for a giant rabbit terrorising a town's allotments and vegetable patches days before the annual vegetable-growing competition. As Wallace and his trusty companion are called into action with their pest control business, a dastardly Lord Victor Quartermaine competes to capture the Were-Rabbit and win the heart of a beautiful lady.
programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit

programme.desc: Award-winning DreamWorks animation from the Aardman team, telling the story of a band of chickens doomed to a life of egg-laying on a Yorkshire chicken farm. When a flamboyant American rooster arrives on the scene, the hens hope he can teach them to fly to freedom. However, when a chicken-pie making machine is installed, their need becomes urgent, and they must devise other means of escape.
programme.title: Chicken Run

programme.desc: Matilda is a gifted child, more gifted than any other, but her parents won't let her go to school. She teaches herself for years by going to the library and reading everything she sees. Eventually she convinces her parents to let her go to school, but discovers her special talents are needed to protect the school and her lovely teacher from the evil headmistress.
programme.title: Matilda

programme.desc: Perennial family favourite about Dorothy, a young girl from the American Midwest, who is swept by a cyclone to a magical kingdom over the rainbow. There she meets a scarecrow, a tin man and a cowardly lion, who join her on a quest to find the all-powerful Wizard of Oz, the only man who can help her get back to Kansas. However, the Wicked Witch of the West has other plans for Dorothy and her new friends.
programme.title: The Wizard of Oz

programme.desc: On a remote island, a wealthy entrepreneur creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening the attraction to the public, he invites a top palaeontologist, palaeobotanist, mathematician/theorist, and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park. Their park visit is anything but tranquil as the park's security system breaks down, and the prehistoric creatures break out.
programme.title: Jurassic Park

programme.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.
programme.title: Jaws

programme.desc: Hot-shot police officer Nicholas Angel smells foul play when the residents of a sleepy Somerset village start to die in seemingly terrible accidents. He must work with a local officer, Danny Butterman, to uncover the truth.
programme.title: Hot Fuzz

programme.desc: Asked to be maid of honour, the best friend of a bride must suddenly face off with an alpha bridesmaid, a woman who clearly wants to take over her job and her best friend status.
programme.title: Bridesmaids

programme.desc: Shaun's humdrum existence takes a turn for the interesting when the undead take over London. Leaping into action, Shaun gathers his loved ones in the safest place he knows. Shaun, his mum and her boyfriend, his girlfriend, Liz, and his flatmates Ed and Pete fight off a fate worse than death from the local pub.
programme.title: Shaun of the Dead

programme.desc: When dictator Joseph Stalin dies, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, confusion remains as to who is running the country.
programme.title: The Death of Stalin
